concept.concept: Illustrated steaming mug inside a mug design with falling leaves and the phrase 'This Is My Whole Personality Until Spring'.

Surround the composition with 8-10 falling autumn leaves of varying sizes scattered asymmetrically around the main mug. Use solid color blocks with no gradients, no shading, no photorealism, and sharp clean edges in a screen-print aesthetic. Color palette: warm burnt orange, deep chocolate brown, cream white, mustard gold, and rust red. Bold retro serif text arched above reads 'THIS IS MY WHOLE PERSONALITY UNTIL SPRING'. Plain solid cream background, generous margins, all elements centered and away from edges. High contrast, readable at 12x16 inches from across a room.
